observation: Rear dry ring basin and stacked white pipes sit behind a broad tan canopy.
Blue rear basin connects down the right route around the unchanged canopy.
Roofed garden tower overlooks dry side pools and small pale center blocks.
Blue side basins and cyan source routes surround the central tan column.
Long tan aqueduct arches over a dry stack of pipes at the front.
Blue upper channels and curved descending flow remain visible below the aqueduct.
Two green rings sit on the long rear canopy above dry left and front pools.
Blue foreground basin and white loop are clearly visible beneath the broad canopy.
Long planted rear roof faces dry roofed front courtyards and white pipe stacks.
Blue side basins connect around the center under the preserved roof structures.
Green ring on the left and tiered planted roofs frame dry side basins.
High white loop connects three blue basins beside the roofed right garden.
Tall central source rises between tan roofed corners and dry foreground basins.
Blue side basins and long elevated bridge remain visible on both sides of the arch.
Dry roofed basins surround the narrow stream at the tall central tower.
Blue high basin and lower side pools connect around the tan central tower.
Rear source and small green ring sit among compact dry roofed gardens.
White raised loop and blue foreground basin remain framed below the rear arches.
Blue and purple rear sources face a dry planted front-right basin.
Purple front flow and blue upper route remain separately colored around the tan blocks.
Tall tan column and green ring rise above the dry front planted pool.
Long white bridge connects to the blue foreground pool beside the green ring.
Central planted canopy covers pale channels beside a dry tall right-hand basin.
Blue right basin and raised stone loop remain visible around the tan middle platform.
